stimulus.body: A 2019 study of 900 immigrant families in rural Kenya found 65% lived near a pollution source, while 15% did not.

questions.stem: Explain the 2019 Kenya finding about environmental inequality.

answer.exemplar: A 2019 study of 900 immigrant families in rural Kenya found 65% lived near a pollution source, while 15% did not. This illustrates environmental inequality: the unequal exposure of groups to environmental hazards. A careful reading links the group-level pattern to the wider social structure rather than to any single person, and it distinguishes this idea from competing accounts that locate the cause elsewhere.

questions.explanation: The finding illustrates environmental inequality: the unequal exposure of groups to environmental hazards. The 65 percent versus 15 percent split in rural Kenya shows why this reading fits better than the alternatives.
questions.hint: Ask what the smaller share has in common with the larger one.
